Last official military parade of the Bundeswehr, unfortunately not very spectacular (mid 80s)

Germany officially doesn't hold military parades, this is because of the role Germany had during world war 2. It is allowed for german soldiers to accept invitations to other country's military parades. In Germany however, there are only unofficial and private so called "Fieldparades" that take place next to big maneuvers and are represented by the attending Commanders. During these however, the soldiers do not wear any special kind of uniforms, nor parade uniforms and strict discipline is not enforced, instead the focus is turned to the weapons and vehicles that the soliders present. During the Cold War, Germany and its Bundeswehr did execute some military parades publicly, even though officially they were also refered to as "Fieldparades", despite this, In reality they were closer to historical military parades. (Wikipedia)
